meta.scope: UAE Batch 2 — Oil production/exports, sovereign wealth (Mubadala/ADIA framing), and labour/expatriate densification.

candidates.title: Crude oil production and export statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from national and energy monitoring sources
candidates.description: Statistics on crude oil and condensate production and exports. Production is concentrated in Abu Dhabi; export volumes are large and responsive to OPEC+ and market conditions. Hydrocarbons remain a core current-account and fiscal contributor alongside the diversified non-oil base.
referenced_by: National accounts and BOP goods account
candidates.notes: Core hydrocarbon production and external-earnings node.

candidates.title: Sovereign wealth funds framing (ADIA, Mubadala)
candidates.publisher: Derived from fund and official sources
candidates.description: Framing of the major Abu Dhabi sovereign investment vehicles (ADIA, Mubadala and related). Multi-hundred-billion-dollar asset bases; dual role in international portfolio investment and domestic diversification under national strategies.

candidates.title: Labour force and expatriate employment statistics
candidates.description: Labour-force and employment statistics by citizenship. The workforce is overwhelmingly non-national; Emiratisation policies and private-sector localisation targets are continuously tracked alongside overall employment and participation.
candidates.notes: Core labour-market densification under expatriate-majority structure.

candidates.title: UAE oil–sovereign–labour densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from energy, fund and labour sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding oil production/exports, sovereign wealth fund framing, and labour/expatriate statistics into a coherent hydrocarbon–investment–labour layer.
